correctness.rationale: Exact conditional drift identity with deterministic total yields the normalized martingale. Uniform square-summable rescaled martingale increments and Doob maximal inequality prove that late noise is negligible. Shared uniforms match every fixed prefix to a pure Pólya urn with Dirichlet limit; logarithmic product asymptotics yield finite- and infinite-λ uniform L2 profiles. An independent exact finite-state DP passed 280206 assertions; infinity rests on the proof.
